subject: Execution sanction: final approval, signature timing, and startslot orchestration
messages:
From: Rishi Malhotra <rishi@redwood.com>
To: Sanjay Rao <sanjay@brightcart.com>
Cc: Camila Reyes <camila_reyes@redwood.com>, Irene Choi <irene_choi@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>
Date: 2027-10-19T09:12:00-07:00
Subject: MAP sync + final approval steps / proposed signature window and startslot

Hi Sanjay / team —

Thanks again for the productive eval week. We pulled together the updated mutual action plan and a condensed signoff playbook (attached). To keep the timeline tight and ensure your procurement/legal have everything they need, here are the concrete asks and proposed timing: 

1) Final approvals required (owners):
   - Commercial signoff (BrightCart finance) — Sanjay / Priya
   - Legal redline complete (BrightCart legal) — Priya
   - Redwood contract signoff (Legal Ops) — Irene
   - Implementation lead confirmation (CS) — Camila

2) Signature flow and windows (recommended):
   - Two-signer DocuSign flow (BrightCart primary signer -> Redwood counter-sign)
   - Preferred signing window: Oct 25 — Oct 28 (we can open on Oct 24 if needed)
   - Fallback window: Nov 1 — Nov 5 (push to later startdate)

3) Start date / Day-one options
   - Option A (preferred): Nov 8 start (training week + reserved capacity)
   - Option B (accelerated): Nov 1 start (requires expedited legal review, smaller pilot first 2 days)

4) Attachments and artifacts
   - BrightCart_MAP_v3.pdf — finalized MAP with milestone owners and acceptance criteria
   - Signature_Route.xlsx — our recommended signer order and time-zone slots

Next steps requested from your side by EOD Tue (Oct 20):
- Confirm which start-date option you prefer (Nov 1 or Nov 8)
- Confirm if your legal wants the two-signer DocuSign or an internal countersign route
- Share any outstanding risk items we should address in the SOW (SLA wording, data residency notes)

Irene / Camila — I put you on copy to confirm Redwood's counter-sign availability and to surface any known legal/implementation blockers.

Thanks,
Rishi
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
[Attachment: BrightCart_MAP_v3.pdf (PDF)]
[Attachment: Signature_Route.xlsx (Excel)]

Rishi — thanks, looks clean. Quick notes from our side: 

- Priya (legal) will run a final pass today on the SLA clause around uptime credits; expect 1 wording ask (cap on credits) — should not block signature, but flagging.
- Procurement prefers DocuSign two-signer flow (primary: me; secondary: Priya) — we can sign Oct 26 or Oct 27 morning PST.
- We have an internal approval committee meeting Oct 25; I should be able to confirm the final greenlight immediately after that meeting.

If you can reserve DocuSign slots Oct 26–27, I will lock down the internal approvers. Also please confirm who at Redwood will be the counter-signer (Irene?) and whether you need any additional SSO/KMS evidence for our procurement packet.

— Sanjay
VP, GTM | BrightCart

- We can support either startslot. Operationally, Nov 8 gives us full runway for a 3-day enablement + 2-day pilot; Nov 1 compresses training into a half-day and requires a lighter pilot scope.
- Counter-sign: Irene is the correct legal counter-sign; she confirms availability Oct 28 and Nov 2 for countersign. If procurement signs on Oct 26/27 we can countersign Oct 28.
- To accelerate, recommend: two-signer DocuSign + pre-approved SOW appendix for training scope. I attached a short onboarding checklist we will run on day one.

If BrightCart confirms Oct 26 signature, Redwood is prepared to execute countersign on Oct 28 and schedule enablement for Nov 8. If you need Nov 1 start, we will prioritize an accelerated enablement (add another engineer for day 0).

Great — thanks everyone for the quick turnaround. This message is the final orchestration note and action list so we have a single source of truth for the close and go/no-go.

Confirmed items:
- BrightCart to execute DocuSign primary signature: Oct 26 (preferred) or Oct 27 latest.
- Redwood counter-sign target: Oct 28 (Irene to countersign)
- Start date: Nov 8 (confirmed by BrightCart during approval committee)
- SLA wording: Redwood agrees to a clarified uptime-credit cap; Irene will send the final clause to Priya by EOD Oct 22 for sign-off.

DocuSign setup: https://app.docusign.com/exec/BRGHT-2384 (live envelope; placeholder until Priya confirms signer)
Attachments in the envelope: BrightCart_MAP_v3.pdf, Final_SOW_Appendix.pdf (we will auto-populate appendix once Priya confirms minor SLA language)

Action items (owners & due dates):
- Sanjay / Priya: confirm primary signer and approve envelope by Oct 25 EOD (BrightCart) — owner: Sanjay (DONE after Oct 25 meeting)
- Priya: confirm SLA clause or provide counter-language by Oct 22 EOD — owner: Priya
- Irene: Redwood counter-sign availability & final clause approval by Oct 22 EOD — owner: Irene
- Camila: schedule Day-one enablement for Nov 8 and notify engineering roster by Oct 29 — owner: Camila
- Rishi: monitor envelope and confirm countersign once received — owner: Rishi

Fallback plan (if signature slips beyond Oct 28):
- Move startdate to Nov 15 and run a 2-week pilot (reduced throughput) while legal closes the outstanding SLA item.

Please reply-all with a one-line confirmation when you have the internal approvals locked so I can release the production reservation for your account.

Thanks and excited to have BrightCart live with Redwood.

— Rishi
